properties.description:
Creates an incident when XposedOrNot reports a breach exposure that was not previously seen for a monitored domain.
The first sync of each domain is treated as a baseline, so historical breaches of a newly verified domain do not raise incidents.
Breaches added to XposedOrNot in the last 7 days are always reported, so the first breach of a previously clean domain is not missed.
properties.query:
let lookback = 14d;
let window = 1h;
let baselineGrace = 30m;
let recentBreach = 7d;
let Exposures = XposedOrNotExposures_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | extend IngestedAt = ingestion_time()
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(IngestedAt) by Domain, Email, BreachName;
let DomainBaseline = Exposures
    | summarize DomainFirstSeen = min(FirstSeen) by Domain;
let Catalog = XposedOrNotBreachCatalog_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, BreachedDate, AddedDate, PasswordRisk, ExposedData, ExposedRecords) by BreachName
    | project-away TimeGenerated;
Exposures
| where FirstSeen > ago(window)
| join kind=inner DomainBaseline on Domain
| join kind=leftouter Catalog on BreachName
| where FirstSeen > DomainFirstSeen + baselineGrace or AddedDate > ago(recentBreach)
| extend PasswordRisk = iff(isempty(PasswordRisk), "unknown", PasswordRisk)
| extend ExposedDataTypes = strcat_array(ExposedData, "; ")
| summarize
    TimeGenerated = max(FirstSeen),
    ExposedEmailCount = dcount(Email),
    ExposedEmails = strcat_array(make_set(Email, 25), ", ")
    by Domain, BreachName, BreachedDate, AddedDate, PasswordRisk, ExposedDataTypes, ExposedRecords
| extend Severity = iff(PasswordRisk in ("plaintext", "easytocrack"), "High", "Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, Domain, BreachName, BreachedDate, AddedDate, PasswordRisk, Severity, ExposedEmailCount, ExposedEmails, ExposedDataTypes, ExposedRecords

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The XposedOrNot solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests breach exposure data for your verified domains and raises incidents when new exposures appear, so compromised accounts can be remediated before they are abused.

Key Features:

  • Breach exposure monitoring for every domain verified in your XposedOrNot account
  • Incidents for new breach exposures, with severity raised for plaintext and easy to crack passwords
  • Configurable refresh schedule and API key entry on the data connector page
  • Workbook for breach exposure analytics, risk breakdown and trends

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

  1. Codeless Connector Framework (CCF)

  2. Azure Monitor Data Collection Rules

Data Connectors: 1, Parsers: 1, Workbooks: 1, Analytic Rules: 1
